name: The TanStack AI adapter for Jev
gain: The same Jev call from a TanStack AI product. The package states no number of its own, so only adoption can be shown.
how: Only for a product already on @tanstack/ai: add @tanstack/ai-typesafe and route the label-picking call through it, with today's call as the fallback.
replaces: A label-picking chat call in a TanStack AI product.
trade_offs: It only helps a product already using @tanstack/ai.
Everything in Jev's own trade-offs still applies.
usage_signal: Usage and Cost API: high call count with few output tokens per call

gain_model.formula: calls * (current_cost_per_call - decision_cost_per_call), plus p50 latency difference

inputs.name: calls
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

inputs.name: current_cost_per_call
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

inputs.name: decision_cost_per_call
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

test_recipe.what_to_compare: agreement with the current call, p50 latency, fallback rate

verify_rule: Cost line and p50 for that call over 14 days; fallback rate under the gate

change_recipe.how: Only for a product already on @tanstack/ai: add @tanstack/ai-typesafe and route the label-picking call through it, with today's call as the fallback.
change_recipe.left_off: Nothing else changes; the new path sits behind a setting until a person turns it on
